title: BMCP RecoveryJoin Proof Schema 1.0.2
description: RecoveryJoin 1.0.2 adds explicit owner-signed snapshot membership proof payloads for every represented owner admission, binding exact ledger row identity, owner-local high-water, frozen snapshot/root, gate/scope and anti-rollback state. This artifact defines structural shape only; owner-specific signature verification and completeness remain semantic responsibilities.

owner_snapshot_membership_proofs.description: Owner-authored proof payloads for exact admission rows referenced by admission joins or no-participant dispositions.

request_highwaters.description: May be empty when the corresponding owner ledger has no high-water entries. Do not synthesize an entry merely to make an empty ledger schema-valid.

admission_highwaters.description: May be empty when the corresponding owner ledger has no high-water entries. Do not synthesize an entry merely to make an empty ledger schema-valid.

allOf.$comment: §5.7 says target_set_digest and forget_fence_namespace_ref SHOULD be conditionally required for D LINEAGE/BARRIER_MEMBERSHIP. They are defined as optional properties; schema-level MUST enforcement is not inferred.

forgetFenceGeneration.description: D ForgetFence namespace generation; distinct from ProducerRegistrationHighWater.

forgetFenceCurrentnessProof.description: H-side proposed D currentness-proof shape from H-RJ-HW-01 §5.4. This is not evidence that D has issued or adopted this proof format.

lineage_manifest_digest.$comment: Named by §5.8 but omitted from the §5.4 object and required list; optional here pending clarification.

$comment: Derived from H-RJ-HW-01 §§5–7. This is a structural artifact only; it does not authenticate D-issued proofs or establish currentness. The contract H-RJ-HW-01 §11.7 pins the artifact filename bmcp.recovery-join-1.0.2.schema.json and source Blob 4b664e3bce465499bcdfd93796349a4ba7074002. That pinned source snapshot had a stale schema_version=1.0.0 const despite its 1.0.2 $id/title. This delivered artifact follows the contract's explicit 1.0.2 artifact identity: filename, $id and schema_version const all say 1.0.2. The pinned Blob is retained as provenance for the source snapshot, not as the final extended artifact Blob. H-RJ-HW-01 §5.4 names the currentness-proof field forget_fence_generation; §5.9 pseudocode instead refers to proof.fence_generation. This schema follows the explicit §5.4 JSON object and does not add an alias. H-RJ-HW-01 §5.8 requires lineage_manifest_digest to be added to the currentness proof but does not state whether it is required. The property is admitted but not required pending authority clarification. H-RJ-HW-01 §5.7 says target_set_digest and forget_fence_namespace_ref SHOULD be conditionally required for D LINEAGE/BARRIER_MEMBERSHIP evidence; they remain optional at schema level because the contract does not say MUST. H-RJ-HW-01 §§3.5/4.2 refer to snapshot.owner_specific_high_waters.producer_registration_high_water, while §§5.5/7.1 specify a top-level ownerSnapshot producer_registration_high_water. This schema follows the explicit schema-addition snippets and summary in §§5.5/7.1; it does not invent the owner_specific_high_waters map.
